meaning: 女孩们愿意冒险去上学
usageNote: take a risk就是'豁出去冒险'，日常超常用！比risk it更正式一点点，表示明知有危险还是干了💪

examples.en: So girls are happy to take a risk in order to get to school, even when the roads are dangerous.
examples.zh: 所以即使道路危险，女孩们也愿意冒险去上学。

examples.en: He was happy to take a risk in order to save his friend.
examples.zh: 为了救朋友，他愿意冒这个险。
